senses.sense_definition: To have existed since a particular time in the past.

examples.text: The castle walls <w>date</w> back to the 12th century.

target_lang_translations.nl: De kasteelmuren <w>dateren</w> uit de 12e eeuw.
target_lang_translations.de: Die Burgmauern <w>reichen</w> bis ins 12. Jahrhundert <w>zurück</w>.
target_lang_translations.fr: Les murs du château <w>datent</w> du XIIe siècle.
target_lang_translations.it: Le mura del castello <w>risalgono</w> al XII secolo.
target_lang_translations.es: Las murallas del castillo <w>datan</w> del siglo XII.
target_lang_translations.zh: 城堡的城墙可以<w>追溯到</w>12世纪。

examples.text: This tradition <w>dates</w> from the Victorian era.

target_lang_translations.ru: Эта традиция <w>ведет начало</w> с викторианской эпохи.

target_lang_translations.fr: Cette tradition <w>date</w> de l'époque victorienne.

target_lang_translations.es: Esta tradición <w>data</w> de la época victoriana.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Существовать с определенного времени в прошлом.

senses.sense_definition: To determine the age of an object or event.

examples.text: Scientists used carbon to <w>date</w> the fossils.

target_lang_translations.nl: Wetenschappers gebruikten koolstof om de fossielen te <w>dateren</w>.

target_lang_translations.de: Wissenschaftler nutzten Kohlenstoff, um das Alter der Fossilien zu <w>datieren</w>.
target_lang_translations.fr: Les scientifiques ont utilisé le carbone pour <w>dater</w> les fossiles.
target_lang_translations.it: Gli scienziati hanno usato il carbonio per <w>datare</w> i fossili.
target_lang_translations.tr: Bilim insanları fosilleri <w>tarihlendirmek</w> için karbon kullandılar.

examples.text: It is difficult to <w>date</w> the building of the pyramids precisely.

target_lang_translations.nl: Het is moeilijk om de bouw van de piramides nauwkeurig te <w>dateren</w>.

target_lang_definitions.nl: De ouderdom van een object of gebeurtenis bepalen.
